title: Adebayo Rotilu, who ran media for The Startup Leap evening — 'Harder is easier. That was the line from Eric Ries that stayed with me'
summary: Adebayo Rotilu was Head of Media for the Openseed VC / Startup Leap evening on 9 September, covering both the fireside chat and the podcast recording. Three weeks on, the line he keeps returning to is 'harder is easier' — his reading being that great leaders don't take the shortcut, because the difficult moments are where the work actually happens.
blockquote:
Harder is easier.

That was the line from Eric Ries that stayed with me after the fireside chat on 9 September about his new book, Incorruptible: Why Good Companies Go Bad and How Great Companies Stay Great.

I was Head of Media for the evening, covering both the fireside chat and the podcast recording, so I had a front row seat.

His point: we're always looking for the easy way out, but great leaders don't take shortcuts. They lean into the difficult moments, because that's where the real work happens.
attribution_title: Head of Media for the evening · Digital imaging product marketing · Former founder
